scanner_doubts: One of the two qe-writing-001 hits in greek_square.md is a false positive: the hit at line 23 is the verbatim Bertrand Russell quotation inside the ```{epigraph} fence at 22-24. It genuinely contains 7 sentences, but one-sentence-per-paragraph cannot be applied to quoted material without altering the quotation, so the only correct action is to leave it. check_writing_001 (tools/qestyle_rules.py 266-273) walks `_paragraph_blocks(doc)` with no exemption for `{epigraph}` or blockquote content. The second hit (line 86, inside a `{note}`) is a fair one. In this series only geom_series.md and greek_square.md use `{epigraph}`, so the blast radius is small here - geom_series' epigraph at 44 is a single sentence and is not hit - but the exemption is worth adding before the rule meets a lecture that quotes at length.
